The official page is OpenAI's API deprecations page: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations. The old URL, platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations, redirects there.

Today is 2026-10-16. These are the next shutdowns, soonest first:

| Shutdown | Models | Recommended replacement |
|---|---|---|
| **Oct 23, 2026** | `gpt-3.5-turbo`, `gpt-4-turbo`, `gpt-4` / `gpt-4-0613`, `gpt-4-1106-preview`, `gpt-4o-2024-05-13`, `o1`, `o3-mini`, `o4-mini`, and the fine-tuned `ft-` variants of `gpt-3.5-turbo`, `o4-mini`, `babbage-002` and `davinci-002` | `gpt-5.6-terra` for GPT-3.5, o4-mini and the babbage/davinci fine-tunes; `gpt-5.6-sol` for GPT-4, GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o, o1 and o3-mini |
| Oct 23, 2026 | `o1-pro` | `gpt-5.6-sol` with `reasoning.mode: pro` |
| Oct 23, 2026 | `gpt-4.1-nano`, including its fine-tune | `gpt-5.6-luna` |
| Oct 23, 2026 | `gpt-image-1` | `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` or `gpt-image-2.5-flare` |
